title: TENET: One Step Toward Test-Driven Development for Repository-Level Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2509.24148v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Test-Driven Development (TDD) is a widely adopted practice that requires developers to create and execute tests alongside implementation. With recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs), developers can shift from manually writing the code to defining tests as executable specifications and delegating code synthesis to AI agents. However, enabling repository-level TDD under developer-written tests is challenging, requiring: (1) specification enhancement: identifying a concise yet representative test subset from large suites with rich task semantics; (2) retrieval augmentation: using tests to guide reasoning and context retrieval; and (3) test-driven refinement: interpreting test feedback for iterative improvement. We propose TENET, an agentic framework for repository-level code generation under the TDD paradigm. TENET includes: (1) a test harness mechanism that selects a concise test suite to maximize diversity of the target

translated_title: TENET：迈向仓库级代码生成测试驱动开发的一步
translated_abstract: 测试驱动开发（TDD）是一种广泛采用的实践，要求开发者在实现代码的同时创建并执行测试。随着大型语言模型（LLMs）的近期进展，开发者可以从手动编写代码转向将测试定义为可执行规范，并将代码合成委托给AI代理。然而，在开发者编写的测试下实现仓库级TDD具有挑战性，需要：（1）规范增强：从大型测试套件中识别出简洁但具有代表性的测试子集，以捕捉丰富的任务语义；（2）检索增强：利用测试来指导推理和上下文检索；（3）测试驱动改进：解释测试反馈以进行迭代改进。我们提出了TENET，一个在TDD范式下用于仓库级代码生成的代理框架。TENET包括：（1）一个测试工具机制，选择简洁的测试套件以最大化目标任务的多样性。
tldr: TENET是一个代理框架，通过选择多样化的测试子集、利用测试指导检索和迭代改进，实现了仓库级代码生成中的测试驱动开发。
en_tdlr: TENET is an agentic framework that enables test-driven development for repository-level code generation by selecting diverse test subsets, using tests to guide retrieval, and iteratively refining based on test feedback.
